summary.document_title: Sprint 24 Planning & Enterprise Product Sync Notes
summary.executive_summary: Captures three enterprise merchant onboarding requirements: federated OIDC/SAML 2.0 SSO, a requested monthly CSV settlement export (already covered by FIN-101), and an architectural upgrade to FIN-104 adding exponential backoff and an SQS Dead-Letter Queue.
risks_and_dependencies: Deprecating legacy session cookies (FIN-102) requires coordinated migration for active enterprise tenants.
SQS Dead-Letter Queue provisioning requires IAM and Terraform updates from Platform Infrastructure.
open_questions: Should Phase 1 support IdP-initiated SAML login or strictly SP-initiated OIDC flows?
What is the target p99 enqueue latency SLA for outbound webhook events?

stories.title: Enterprise Federated SSO via OIDC & SAML 2.0 with JIT Provisioning
stories.user_story: As an Enterprise Merchant Administrator, I want federated login via Okta/Azure AD (OIDC & SAML 2.0) with MFA enforcement and JIT role provisioning, so that Tier-1 enterprise tenants can onboard securely without legacy passwords.
stories.technical_description: Implement OIDC and SAML 2.0 authentication handlers validating IdP MFA claims, map IdP groups to RBAC roles on login, and deprecate the legacy 24-hour Basic-Auth cookie flow in FIN-102 for enterprise accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given an enterprise tenant configured with Okta or Azure AD OIDC/SAML, when a user authenticates with valid MFA claims, then a scoped JWT session is issued and JIT RBAC roles are assigned.
Given an authentication token missing verified MFA claims, when login is attempted, then access is rejected with HTTP 403 and a structured security audit event.
Given an enterprise-flagged tenant, when attempting legacy password login from FIN-102, then the request is redirected to the tenant's configured IdP.
stories.priority_rationale: Directly unblocks three Tier-1 enterprise merchant onboardings and replaces legacy session handling.
stories.alignment_notes: Net-new federated SSO capability that supersedes FIN-102 for enterprise tenants.

stories.title: Merchant Portal Monthly Settlement CSV Export
stories.user_story: As a Merchant Finance Manager, I want to download monthly settlement transactions as a UTF-8 CSV file up to 50,000 rows, so that I can reconcile monthly payouts in external accounting systems.
stories.technical_description: Provide a portal export endpoint streaming monthly transaction records in CSV format up to 50,000 rows.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merchant with <= 50,000 monthly transactions, when clicking Export CSV, then a valid UTF-8 CSV file downloads within 5 seconds.
Given a dataset exceeding 50,000 rows, when export is requested, then pagination or date-range scoping is enforced with a clear UI message.
All exported currency amounts and ISO-8601 timestamps match settlement ledger totals.
stories.priority_rationale: Standard merchant reporting feature already scheduled and in progress.
stories.alignment_notes: Exact duplicate of existing In-Progress backlog item FIN-101 (Monthly Transaction CSV Export up to 50,000 rows). Do not create a new sprint ticket.

stories.title: Webhook Exponential Backoff & SQS Dead-Letter Queue Replay
stories.user_story: As an Enterprise Integration Engineer, I want failed payment webhooks retried with exponential backoff up to 6 hours and persisted to a Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ), so that no payment events are lost during merchant maintenance windows.
stories.technical_description: Upgrade FIN-104 from fixed 3x 60s retries to exponential backoff with full jitter (up to 6 hours) and route exhausted payloads to an AWS SQS DLQ with an authenticated replay API endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Given a downstream merchant endpoint returning HTTP 5xx/timeout, when webhook delivery fails, then retries follow exponential backoff with jitter over a 6-hour window.
Given a webhook that exhausts all retry attempts, when final failure occurs, then the payload and delivery metadata are persisted to the AWS SQS DLQ.
Given events in the DLQ, when an authorized merchant calls POST /v1/webhooks/dlq/replay, then queued events are re-dispatched idempotently.
stories.priority_rationale: Prevents data loss of critical payment notifications during merchant maintenance windows.
stories.alignment_notes: Expands scope of existing backlog item FIN-104 from fixed 3x retry to 6-hour exponential backoff + SQS DLQ.
